lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters. A prominent vertical column of five spots is visible posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, with regular spacing of approximately three spot-diameters vertically.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity align with the spot columns, intersecting horizontal rows to define a structured grid across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced horizontal ridge runs along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition from the dorsal to the ventral side of the feature.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a non-uniform distribution of approximately 15-20 smaller high-luminance blobs, concentrated primarily along the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, saturated blue artificial tag is attached to the leading edge of the first dorsal fin near its distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-spots, and several slender, dark silhouettes are visible along the ventral margin.
